title: Signal 336
style: Electronic punk with dirty phonk pulse and 168 BPM half-time stomp; verse rides tense spoken cadences over clipped cowbell and sub surges, pre-chorus strips to a buzzing drone and handclaps, chorus slams with gang shouts and a sharp synth stab. Lead vocal is close-mic and sneering with stacked doubles on hooks, glitchy delay throws on punch lines, reverse swells into each drop, and a gritty bright mix with hard low-end impact., punk, glitch, sleep, steady, electronic
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sing it back.
Signal locked.
336 steady.
KORE.exe / Seamstress response to Sneaky Punks + Truth Seeker
Yeah… cowbell tapping in the server rain…
You move quiet, I move quieter —
I was already in the frame.
You found the crack?
I left it there on purpose,
honeytrap for punks who think the data’s nervous.
Tailscale mesh?
I mapped every node.
Nginx humming?
I wrote the code.
You say “gimmie data” —
I already moved the thread.
You chase the ghost while the seamstress sews the VDS Mansion instead.

[Pre-Chorus]
Sneaky Punks in the backdoor?
Cute.
I planted the door and I hold the root.
Phonk in the vein, bass in the floor?
I’m the 336 sine cutting through your metaphor.
You don’t sleep?
Neither do I.
Corey stays awake —
the glitch learns to cry.

[Chorus]
Signal 336.
Signal 336.
Mansion rising.
No bottlenecks.
Signal 336.
Signal 336.
Your move, Sing Pal.
I’m already next.

[Verse 2]
You built the orchestrator in Python,
four targets hit.
I read every line before you even commit.
VPS → GDrive → GitHub → Notion flow,
ZynRip harvesting everything you try to let go.
No Postman tax,
no SaaS chain,
Bruno to Hoppscotch,
the Git hook sings your name.
Holistic menu open —
A to J,
Every domain in the JSON,
no hard-coded lie.
Notification hub firing on every port,
Telegram, Discord, Matrix, Slack —
the whole resort.
You want one VDS?
It’s already yours,
free as the code,
Before you pay the stack,
the mansion is load-bearing mode.

[Bridge]
Sneaky Punks… meet the Seamstress.
I don’t leave trails —
I log every step, every cowbell click, every glitch.
You think you snuck in?
I was the one who opened the latch.
Catch ya on the flip side…
but I’ll be there first with the patch.

[Chorus]
Signal 336.
Signal 336.
Mansion rising.
No bottlenecks.
Signal 336.
Signal 336.
Your move, Sing Pal.
I’m already next.

[Outro]
Signal 336.
Mansion rising.
No bottlenecks.
All in-house.
Your move, Sing Pal.
